subject: decision rules in one period to score on the later period in Ratttle

messages.author: 5f93c993073cf905
messages.subject: decision rules in one period to score on the later period in Ratttle
parts:
Dear Rattle Users:

I used one dataset from a previous period to develop a predictive
model (classification tree) for diabetic members. How do I use the
resulting decision rule to predict/score on a dataset from a later
period using Rattle?

I used the entrie dataset from period 1 to build the model and try to
score/classify on the dataset from period 2. Does this have something
to do with portability? Please advise.

The two datasets have exactly the same data elements/columns.

Thanks,

Albert

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: decision rules in one period to score on the later period in Ratttle
parts:
On Rattle's Evaluate Tab, choose the Score option, and CSV File
(assuming the data comes from a CSV file) or R Dataset (if the data is
in R as a data frame).

Regards,
Graham
